msg: No fhirVersion is declared. The CMS-0057-F APIs must be conformant to HL7 FHIR Release 4.0.1 (R4).
msg_bad: fhirVersion is {v}. The CMS-0057-F APIs must be conformant to HL7 FHIR Release 4.0.1 (R4); an STU3 or R5 server does not satisfy the rule.

msg: No US Core profile is referenced anywhere in the statement. The CMS-0057-F APIs must return the USCDI clinical data set through US Core R4 profiles.
No SMART App Launch / OAuth 2.0 security service is declared. The Patient Access API must let a member authorise a third-party app without contacting the payer.
A plaintext http:// endpoint is declared. Every CMS-0057-F API endpoint, including the OAuth 2.0 authorize and token URLs, must be TLS-protected.
Patient Access API: no ExplanationOfBenefit resource is declared, so adjudicated claims and encounter data cannot be returned to the member.
Patient Access API: no ClaimResponse resource is declared. CMS-0057-F adds prior authorization requests and decisions (drugs excluded) to the Patient Access API from 1 January 2027.
Prior Authorization API: no Claim $submit operation is declared, so a provider cannot send a prior authorization request to this server.
Prior Authorization API: no $inquire operation is declared. Without it a provider cannot check the status of a pending prior authorization.
Documentation requirements: no $questionnaire-package operation is declared, so the payer's documentation rules are not machine-readable to the provider's EHR.
Provider Access API: no bulk $export operation is declared. CMS-0057-F requires payers to share member data with in-network providers from 1 January 2027.
Payer-to-Payer API: no $member-match operation is declared, so a previous payer cannot identify this member and hand over their data at enrolment.
No REST server mode is declared. A CapabilityStatement offered as evidence for a CMS-0057-F API must describe a server, not a client.
The statement is dated {d} and is {n} days old. Auditors read the date first: refresh it as the APIs are built out.
{n} days left until the CMS-0057-F compliance date of 1 January 2027, with {e} blocking gaps still open in this statement.
